svg.title: Pipeline diagram: input meshes to converted 3D-GS, 4D representation, temporal smoothness regularization, rendered video, VAE encoder, noise selection, and video model
svg.desc: Base frames and content inventory: left input rounded rectangle feeds a dashed 3D cube with a person/table scene; this feeds a blue dashed 4D cube with the same scene. Curved operation/gradient arrows connect the 4D representation to a pink spatial-temporal regularization block and the rendered video frames. The rendered video is a stack of slanted image frames feeding a yellow VAE encoder. At right, a small graph and legend explain operation and gradient; selected noise and add-noise arrows feed a rounded yellow video-model icon. A long dashed gradient return line runs along the bottom. SAM mapping: Original Figure Object video model icon - Constructed Element ID draft_video_model - SAM Asset ID asset_sam_region_000019; the image crop covers only the icon, not the “Video Model” label or adjacent arrows.

symbol.desc: Reusable constructed scene: dark-suited standing person, checker floor, brown table, and green mesh/interaction line.
